tournaments.description: Family-friendly charity ice derby. Every ticket supports the Children's Hospital Foundation of Manitoba and CancerCare Manitoba Foundation; the derby has raised over $536,000 to date and 600 free rods are given away to kids.
tournaments.entry: Tickets go on sale Nov 1, 2026 — see official site

tournaments.description: The 19th annual derby on the frozen waters of Lac du Bonnet — thousands of dollars in cash and prizes, family activities, and food. A non-profit event raising funds for community groups in the Lac du Bonnet area; organizers say plans are underway for the biggest derby yet after a September prize-theft incident (police recovered several items and made an arrest).
tournaments.location: LdB Town Dock, Park Ave & Third St, Lac du Bonnet MB
tournaments.name: Lac du Bonnet Ice Fishing Derby

tournaments.dates: March 6, 2027 — details to follow (announced on official site)

tournaments.description: The 22nd annual Winter Fish-Off — one of the biggest ice derbies in central Canada with a $20,000 grand prize and over $80,000 in guaranteed cash and prizes. A portion of proceeds supports the St.Amant Foundation (over $140,000 raised since 2014).
tournaments.location: West side of Falcon Lake, Whiteshell MB
tournaments.name: Falcon Lake Winter Fish-Off
